findings.claim: ZCode live E2E row uses project-root zcode.json as temp config. ZCode ignores hooks in project config, so the G25 hook probe can never fire there.
findings.evidence: zcode.z.ai/en/docs/hooks (local copy /tmp/wf3/https___zcode.z.ai_en_docs_hooks.html.txt): 'Project-level hooks are not executed in the current version. For security reasons, any hooks configuration in <workspace>/.zcode/config.json <workspace>/zcode.json is ignored ... logged as config_project_hooks_ignored'. Also tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md:43 'project hooks ignored'.
findings.fix: Temp config = temp HOME with ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (hooks.enabled:true) or the installed plugin's hooks/hooks.json. Assert absence of config_project_hooks_ignored in ~/.zcode/cli/log/zcode-<date>.jsonl.

findings.claim: ZCode auto-loads a plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json and hooks/hooks.json. If the release branch ships the Claude Code plugin layout, ZCode runs the Claude Code hook commands and the hook decodes as agent claude-code (wrong tool-name map, wrong data dir, wrong compaction path). No doc names a .zcode-plugin manifest or says how hook.mjs tells ZCode from Claude Code.
findings.evidence: ZCode hooks doc: 'Manifest lookup priority: .zcode-plugin/plugin.json .claude-plugin/plugin.json'; 'The standard hooks/hooks.json loads automatically'; 'the compatibility variables CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA are injected too'. PRD-v2.md:249 manifest list has no ZCode entry; PRD:241 has zcode.ts adapter; hook entry is `node hook.mjs <agent> <event>` (PRD:245).
findings.fix: Add to adapters/table.ts + build/manifests.ts: a .zcode-plugin/plugin.json whose hooks field points to a ZCode-only hooks file, and define how the shared root hooks/hooks.json is kept from running twice (ZCode skips duplicates of the standard file only). Add a GP3 golden: ZCode payload decodes as zcode, not claude-code (e.g. ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT present).

findings.claim: ADR-0016 detects subagents from agent_type on every tool call and reads .claude/agents/<type>.md. For ZCode (row line 42 says 'yes / rewrite supported') neither is shown: ZCode docs list agent_type only on SessionStart, and ZCode subagent definitions are not .claude/agents files. Without detection, the MUST (ADR-0016) is not met on ZCode.
findings.evidence: ZCode hooks doc 'Event Key fields': 'SessionStart source, optionally agent_type model'; 'PreToolUse tool_name tool_input tool_use_id' (no agent_type). ADR-0016:18-19 'The hook payload carries agent_type for tool calls made inside a subagent ... reads .claude/agents/<type>.md'.
findings.fix: Mark ZCode row [U] until a live check (add LV-ZCODE to the harness) shows how a subagent tool call is identified. If it cannot be, apply the subagent-safe path (case B/C) to every ZCode call, decided once in the adapter table.

findings.claim: 'ZCode: v1 footprint none' is wrong. Issue #1268 says users run v1 on ZCode through the codex adapter, i.e. hand-written entries in ~/.zcode/cli/config.json that call the global context-mode bin. After npm uninstall -g these hooks fail, and detectV1('zcode') finds nothing.
findings.evidence: tickets/data/isall.json #1268 title: 'Add native ZCode adapter — its hook schema is Claude Code-compatible (verified working via codex adapter)'. ADR-0011:76 says Codex v1 hooks call the global bin. ZCode user config path: ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (spike-hooks-verified.md:43). Archaeology: cm-main has no zcode code (git grep = 0), so the footprint is user-made, not shipped.
findings.fix: ZCode row: ~/.zcode/cli/config.json hooks.events.* entries whose command contains 'context-mode hook' (any adapter name) + its MCP entry; same removal rule as Claude Code. Note it in the release note next to the Codex line.

findings.claim: ZCode has no project source. The per-agent source table (spike S0) has no ZCode row, but ProjectContext must come from 'the adapter's single projectSource' and missing source makes every tool fail.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:91-96 lists sources for CC, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Gemini, Pi, OMP, Qwen, Kimi, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Zed, Kiro; no ZCode. grep -i zcode tickets/spike-project-source.md = 0 hits.
findings.fix: Run S0 for ZCode (MCP spawn cwd vs. a ${workspace} variable in ZCode MCP config) and add the row; until then ZCode is fixed global mode per G11, stated in the table.

findings.claim: ZCode tool name is [U] but hook matchers and PreToolUse decode depend on it. ZCode matchers with '-' are treated as JS regex, so a generated matcher like mcp__context-mode__ctx_execute changes meaning on ZCode (exact-list mode allows only letters, digits, underscores).
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:193 'Copilot CLI, Kiro, ZCode | [U] | S-NAMES'. ZCode doc: 'Only letters, digits, underscores, and | : exact name-list matching ... Any other characters: treated as a JavaScript regex; an invalid regex skips that matcher'.
findings.fix: S-NAMES for ZCode must also record matcher mode; generate ZCode matchers as anchored regex (^...$) or omit the matcher and filter in decode.
